{{Top|leg}}
'''Pressure tents''' were light-weight, inexpensive shelters designed for survival on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. The tents were constructed of a [[Plastic/Legends|plastic]] skin spread over a series of hollow poles with an [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]]. Larger tents had two airlocks, allowing them to be connected into multiple-roomed structures. [[Gas regulator]]s were installed to maintain the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] within the tents. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[TasCorp]] manufactured three models of pressure tent&mdash;the [[Enviro-Tent 2A]], [[Enviro-Tent 9B|9B]], and [[Enviro-Tent 30C|30C]].<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|Tasariq: The Crystal Planet}}</ref>
